_tracksComment: Double casting? List the two track names here, for example ["Coral", "Pearl"], and use them in cast.json and calendar.json. Leave the list empty for a single cast.
_helpComment: Rehearsals marked "helpers": {"volunteer": "Needed"} in calendar.json show a Sign up button to this address until a parent's name replaces Needed. Replace # with the real sign-up link.

sheet._comment: Published tabs of the Legacy Drama Club Website Content Sheet (CSV links). The site reads the copies in data/sheet-cache/, which the publish workflow refreshes when the Publish tab's stamp changes. A tab with no rows yet leaves the matching data file in charge.
